was: High-desert state park 17 mi E of Lancaster in the Antelope Valley at the base of Saddleback Butte (Joshua-tree woodland). Campground off 170th St E between Ave J and Ave K: ~37 developed sites (~50 primitive total) with shade ramadas, tables, fire rings, potable water, flush toilets and an RV dump station; no hookups. RVs to ~30 ft; FCFS with some sites reservable. --Claude

was: California SRA on the east bank of the Sacramento River 6 mi east of Corning, in a valley-oak riparian forest. 37 sites (RV-friendly to ~31 ft, plus tent-only and a group site); no hookups; flush toilets, hot showers, drinking water. Reservable via ReserveCalifornia, FCFS off-peak. --Claude

Sites vary - some fit 30-ft rigs, others small/unlevel, so pick a larger site for a 23-ft rig. Mix of FCFS and reservable. Open ~May-Oct. --Claude

was: Humboldt County park on the sand spit between the Pacific and Big Lagoon, 7 mi N of Trinidad. 25 sites for tents and small-to-mid RVs/trailers (not all sites fit larger rigs), flush toilets, coin showers, potable water, boat launch. First-come, first-served, 7-night max, on-site host. --Claude

was: Yolo County park (Middle Site) on a bend of Cache Creek ~6 mi N of Rumsey on Hwy 16. 45 individual sites (plus group sites); sites 30-45 cap at 26 ft, others vary. Restrooms, showers, turf areas. ~2/3 reservable (48 hr ahead), rest first-come first-served. --Claude

County-operated. --Claude

County-operated. --Claude
